info.title: Blood Repository Operations API
info.description: Protected connected operations. Detailed access, fields, transitions and recovery limits are in OPERATIONS.md. No MySQL verification or medical interpretation is implied.

get.summary: Reference-only assignment queue and permitted staff directory
get.description: Red Cross Administrator only. Does not return unassigned donor names. Session, active-account and per-action permission checks apply. Every browser write requires X-XSRF-TOKEN. Standard staff API throttling applies.

200.description: Paginated allowed records and module metadata. Catalogs/assignment detail may omit pagination.

200.description: Confirmed module resource or operation result.

payload.description: Laboratory: results keyed by active catalog, optional notes; definitions captured by server. Screening: decision pending/recorded/requires_review and required notes. Eligibility: decision not_assessed/eligible/deferred/not_eligible, required notes and optional staff-entered deferred_until YYYY-MM-DD. No diagnosis is inferred.
